tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
For further information, contact this office during office hours
GST is Exempted for consultancy service as per the Sl No. 3 of Notification No. 12/2017- Central tax (rate) Dated:28.06.2017
Self declaration stating that confirming acceptance of all general and tender conditions without any pre conditions.in a Rs. 100/- Stamp Paperr
The power to cancel and accept the tender rests with the Executive Engineer, RDW&SD, Davanagere
Its responsibilities of TPIA to arrange necessary equipments for testing & quality and technology for inspection of works
Regular/monthly reporting and documentation of progress should submit to Division and Sub Division office regularly
The bidder Should not be blacklisted or debarred by any government authority in a Rs. 100/- Stamp Paper (affidevit)

TPIA contract period shall be initially for a period of one year. It will be extended year-on-year up to maximum period of 03 years from the initial contract date subject to satisfactory performance of the TPIA. If the performance of the TPIA is not satisfactory, then client reserves all the rights to cancel the contract/terminate at any point of time
Original copies of all the above documents (updated in the kppp portal) shall be produced by the Bidder on demand.
Bidder Details Should Upload Detailed Address along with Bank Details
All Terms and Conditions as per Bid document & Document & Notification
